questions.0.explain.t: The SBOM inventories an artifact's components, in formats such as CycloneDX and SPDX.

questions.0.options.1.t: An ingredient list: the components and versions that make up the software

questions.1.explain.t: With queryable SBOMs, the question "where do we use this?" becomes a search, not an all-hands scramble.

questions.1.options.0.t: Quickly finding out which systems use the affected library

questions.1.q.t: What is the main use of an SBOM in an incident like Log4Shell?

questions.2.explain.t: SCA usually generates the SBOM, and the SBOM allows re-evaluating vulnerabilities later, without re-analyzing the code.

questions.2.options.1.t: SCA analyzes and generates the inventory; the SBOM is the inventory that can be shared and re-evaluated

questions.2.options.3.t: SCA depends on the SBOM to exist

questions.2.q.t: What is the relationship between SCA and SBOM?
